caveats_raw10_4.label: honest source-vs-impl gap (encoding derived, not spec-fixed)
caveats_raw10_4.detail: README.md §Honesty: upstream xn6_asm_examples.hexa specifies mnemonics via @xn6 attrs but does NOT fix bit layout. The 24-bit packing is derived to match J2=24 + n=6 funct3 use; treat as candidate encoding, not external spec. imm field is 7 bits (not sigma-tau=8) — one bit consumed by funct3+variant to keep total==J2. Future 32-bit promotion would restore imm=8.
